controls.title: Input Validation
controls.description: Validate all application inputs to ensure that they match the expected type, structure, or format.

controls.title: Parameterised Interfaces
controls.description: Use parameterised interfaces for database queries or system commands.

controls.title: Output Sanitisation
controls.description: Sanitise all application outputs that will be used to render a HTML document.

controls.title: Authentication Mechanism Rate-Limiting
controls.description: Apply rate-limiting on all authentication mechanisms to deter brute-force attacks.

controls.title: Password Requirements
controls.description: Where SSO or passwordless is not supported, verify that user-defined passwords are at least {{ insert: param, as-5_prm_1 }} characters in length and {{ insert: param, as-5_prm_2 }}.

controls.title: Password Salting and Hashing
controls.description: Store passwords as salted hashes using a password hashing scheme that is resistant to offline attacks such as those described in NIST [SP 800-63b](#e59c5a7c-8b1f-49ca-8de0-6ee0882180ce). The salt should be:

controls.title: Access Control Check Enforcement
controls.description: Perform access control checks on all authenticated requests.

controls.title: Secrets Management
controls.description: Securely store secrets in an appropriate secrets management solution with access control enforcement, encryption, and monitoring.

controls.title: Content Security Policy (CSP)
controls.description: Set minimally permissive CSP response headers to mitigate cross-site scripting attacks.

controls.title: HTTP Strict Transport Security (HSTS)
controls.description: Set HTTP Strict Transport Security (HSTS) response headers with a maximum age value of at least 1 year (31536000 seconds) to mitigate protocol downgrade attacks.

controls.title: Session Management
controls.description: Require users to re-authenticate after their session exceeds {{ insert: param, as-11_prm_1 }} hour(s) or terminate the session.

controls.title: Malware Scanning of Uploaded Files
controls.description: Scan file uploads for malware before further processing by the system or users.

controls.title: Exposure of Internal System Details
controls.description: Prevent the unnecessary disclosure of internal system details to end users.

controls.title: Secure Cryptographic Libraries
controls.description: Use reputable and secure cryptographic libraries and functions to handle cryptographic operations.

controls.title: Code Repository
controls.description: Manage the codebase in a central code repository with version control.

controls.title: Commit Signing
controls.description: Configure the code repository to reject unsigned commits.

controls.title: Peer Review
controls.description: Require peer review and approval by a designated reviewer before merging into the default branch.

controls.title: Dependency Manifest Version Pinning
controls.description: Pin direct and transitive dependency versions in the application's dependency manifest.

controls.title: Build and Release Process
controls.description: Use a consistent build and release process that generates a record of how the release artefact was built and deployed.

controls.title: Dependency Installation during Deployment
controls.description: Only install pinned versions in the manifest when installing dependencies during deployment.

controls.title: Software Artefact Signing
controls.description: Sign software artefacts such as code and container images using a trusted source during build.

controls.title: Software Artefact Signature Verification
controls.description: Verify the signatures of code and artefacts before deployment or runtime.

controls.title: Internal Code Collaboration and Sharing
controls.description: Share source code internally to enhance code quality, accelerate innovation, and improve problem-solving efficiency.

controls.title: Vulnerability Assessment
controls.description: Run regular {{ insert: param, st-1_prm_1 }} vulnerability assessment scans for eligible hosts at least every {{ insert: param, st-1_prm_2 }} day(s).

controls.title: Cloud Security Posture Management
controls.description: Set up cloud security posture management that performs continuous configuration scans on cloud assets.

controls.title: Public Vulnerability Disclosure Programme
controls.description: Establish a public reporting channel for disclosing vulnerabilities in public-facing systems via {{ insert: param, st-3_prm_1 }}.

controls.title: Security Testing Programme
controls.description: Conduct and document a {{ insert: param, st-4_prm_1 }} by internal teams or independent external parties every {{ insert: param, st-4_prm_2 }} day(s).

controls.title: Vulnerability Management
controls.description: Triage, prioritise and then remediate or risk accept vulnerabilities that materially impact security within the following timeframe based on severity:

controls.title: Public and Private Subnet Segmentation
controls.description: Place private resources (e.g., databases) in private subnets and public resources (e.g., reverse proxies, web servers) in public subnets within a virtual network.

controls.title: Access Restrictions on CSP Resources Outside Virtual Network
controls.description: Restrict access to CSP resources outside of a virtual network (e.g., Lambda, DynamoDb, API Gateways, S3, CloudFront) using access controls or application layer authorisation.

controls.title: Deny by Default - Allow by Exception
controls.description: Deny network communications traffic by default and allow network communications traffic by exception at managed interfaces.

controls.title: Inter-Private Network Connectivity
controls.description: Route network traffic between private networks without going through the internet.

controls.title: Network and Application Layer Filtering
controls.description: Filter direct traffic from the internet to protect against network and application layer attacks.

controls.title: Valid and Trusted SSL/TLS Certificates
controls.description: Ensure that deployed SSL/TLS certificates are:

controls.title: Secure Inter-Service Communication
controls.description: Ensure communications between services are secure by making them authenticated, authorised and encrypted.

controls.title: Secure Government Enterprise Network (GEN) connectivity
controls.description: Route network traffic between on-premises systems and GCC systems through a secure intermediary.

controls.title: Intrusion Prevention System (IPS)/Intrusion Detection System (IDS)
controls.description: Set up and configure an Intrusion Prevention System (IPS)/Intrusion Detection System (IDS) in the network.

controls.title: Private Network Connectivity
controls.description: Implement strong access controls, encryption, and logging for remote developer, maintainer, or administrator access to private network resources.

controls.title: Alerts on Firewall Configuration Changes
controls.description: Generate alerts to inform appointed administrators on changes to firewall rules, including the enabling or disabling of rules.

controls.title: Backup
controls.description: Backup all important data and systems at least every {{ insert: param, br-1_prm_1 }} day(s), and store backups in a secure and separate location.

controls.title: Recovery Testing
controls.description: Conduct testing of recovery processes at least every {{ insert: param, br-2_prm_1 }} day(s) to ensure their effectiveness.

controls.title: Backup Retention
controls.description: Prevent backups from being modified or deleted for {{ insert: param, br-3_prm_1 }} day(s) or as stipulated in the agency's data retention policies.

controls.title: Disaster Recovery Plan
controls.description: Develop, maintain, and regularly test a disaster recovery plan that ensures critical functions and data can be restored within the Recovery Time Objective (RTO) and Recovery Point Objective (RPO) as determined by business requirements and risk assessments.

controls.title: Data Residency
controls.description: Enforce data residency of primary data in {{ insert: param, dp-1_prm_1 }}.

controls.title: Data at Rest Encryption
controls.description: Encrypt data at rest.

controls.title: Data in Transit Encryption
controls.description: Encrypt data in transit.

controls.title: Government on Commercial Cloud (GCC)
controls.description: Host systems classified as CONFIDENTIAL (CLOUD-ELIGIBLE), RESTRICTED, or OFFICIAL-CLOSED on Commercial Cloud hosting environments in GCC.

controls.title: Sanitisation
controls.description: Sanitise all hardware that stores data at rest. Shred or incinerate data storage meant for retirement.

controls.title: Witness Sanitisation and Destruction of Storage Devices
controls.description: Witness the sanitisation and destruction process to ensure data is removed from storage.

controls.title: Data Loss Prevention
controls.description: Implement data loss prevention mechanisms that monitor data flows, detect sensitive data transfers, and block unauthorised sharing of sensitive data.

controls.title: Separate Log Storage
controls.description: Store logs in a different system or system component than the system component that generated the logs.

controls.title: Tamper-Resistant Log Storage
controls.description: Protect logs from unauthorised access, modification, and deletion.

controls.title: Network Flow Logging
controls.description: Log network traffic going to and from network interfaces.

controls.title: Audit Logging
controls.description: Log management and audit events.

controls.title: Database Logging
controls.description: Log database audit events.

controls.title: Access Logging
controls.description: Log access requests sent to web application firewalls, load balancers, proxies or web servers.

controls.title: Host Security Event Logging
controls.description: Log security events on hosts.

controls.title: Security Log Retention
controls.description: Retain security logs for at least {{ insert: param, lm-8_prm_1 }} day(s).

controls.title: Security Monitoring and Alerting
controls.description: Configure security monitoring to identify potential security violations or breaches and send automated alerts, and respond to them accordingly.

controls.title: Resource Usage Monitoring and Alerting
controls.description: Configure resource usage monitoring to identify abnormal usage and send automated alerts.

controls.title: Service Level Monitoring and Alerting
controls.description: Monitor, maintain and alert on service level objectives (SLOs) and indicators (SLIs) to ensure consistent service performance, availability and reliability.

controls.title: Central Security Log Management and Monitoring
controls.description: Centralise security log management and monitoring with {{ insert: param, lm-12_prm_1 }}.

controls.title: Anomalous Database Activity Monitoring
controls.description: Monitor database activities for anomalous activity.

controls.title: Web Defacement Monitoring
controls.description: Plan for and implement measures to detect and recover from web defacements.

controls.title: Structured Log Formatting
controls.description: Publish logs in a consistent, structured format that aligns with industry standards for easy parsing and analysis.

controls.title: Key Signals Monitoring
controls.description: Monitor key user-facing signals to maintain robust service health and performance.

controls.title: Software delivery performance monitoring
controls.description: Measure and analyse software delivery performance to optimise development velocity and operational efficiency.

controls.title: Whole of Government Application Analytics (WOGAA)
controls.description: Implement Whole of Government Application Analytics (WOGAA) in public facing digital services.

controls.title: Log Sanitisation
controls.description: Sanitise logs to protect classified and sensitive data before it is recorded in any logging system or shared to any third party.

controls.title: User and Entity Behaviour Analytics
controls.description: Implement User and Entity Behaviour Analytics (UEBA) to monitor and analyse user activities for suspicious behaviour and potential threats.

controls.title: Principle of Least Privilege
controls.description: Deny access by default and grant only the minimum permissions required for authorised accounts or processes to perform a specific function based on the account inventory implemented.

controls.title: Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA)
controls.description: Require MFA for privileged accounts at login.

controls.title: Inactive and Expired Accounts
controls.description: Disable or remove {{ insert: param, ac-3_prm_3 }} accounts within {{ insert: param, ac-3_prm_1 }} day(s) from last day of authorised use or have not been used for {{ insert: param, ac-3_prm_2 }} day(s).

controls.title: Access Review
controls.description: Perform an access review {{ insert: param, ac-4_prm_1 }} and remove unauthorised or unnecessary access rights within {{ insert: param, ac-4_prm_2 }} day(s).

controls.title: Endpoint Device Hardening
controls.description: Require hardened endpoint devices for remote developer, maintainer, or administrator access.

controls.title: Default Credentials
controls.description: Change default credentials prior to first use.

controls.title: Singpass/Corppass for External Users
controls.description: Use Singpass or Corppass MFA for digital services that require high level of identity assurance for external users.

controls.title: Automated Account Lifecycle Management
controls.description: Automate account {{ insert: param, ac-8_prm_1 }} for internal users using an account lifecycle management tool.

controls.title: Endpoint Device Management
controls.description: Implement and maintain an endpoint device management solution to ensure the security and integrity of endpoint devices used within the organisation.

controls.title: Identity and Device-Based Access Control
controls.description: Adopt Identity and Device-Based Access Control for secure and context-aware connectivity to private organisational resources.

controls.title: Single User Endpoints
controls.description: Assign each endpoint device to a single designated primary user and enforce the assignment to ensure accountability and enhance security monitoring.

controls.title: Single Sign-On (SSO) for Internal Services and Accounts
controls.description: Use Single Sign-On (SSO) for internal services and accounts.

controls.title: Static Credential Expiry and Rotation
controls.description: Rotate long-lived static credentials such as API keys, user access keys, and personal access tokens every {{ insert: param, ac-13_prm_1 }} day(s) or use short-lived credentials.

controls.title: Inventory of Accounts
controls.description: Establish and maintain an inventory of all accounts and their access rights managed within the system.

controls.title: Validation Testing of Automated Account Lifecycle Management
controls.description: Conduct validation tests on the system integrated with account management tools to ensure secure integration.

controls.title: Unique Base Container Image Tags
controls.description: Use unique base container image tags instead of rolling tags.

controls.title: Minimal Base Container Images
controls.description: Build container images with minimal base images.

controls.title: Runtime Container Secrets
controls.description: Provide secrets and sensitive data to the container at runtime instead of image build time.

controls.title: Non-Privileged Container User
controls.description: Create a non-root user and set it as the default user in the container image build instructions.

controls.title: Dockerfile Linting
controls.description: Lint Dockerfiles before building container images.

controls.title: Read-Only Container Root Filesystem
controls.description: Configure the container root filesystem to be read-only during runtime, except for designated non-persistent storage locations or mounted volumes for stateful storage (e.g., caches, service data).

controls.title: Container Image Scanning
controls.description: Scan container images in the {{ insert: param, cs-7_prm_1 }} for known vulnerabilities.

controls.title: Private Container Image Registries
controls.description: Host built container images in private container registries.

controls.title: Container Orchestrator API Access Control
controls.description: Disable public access to Container Orchestrator API endpoints from the internet.

controls.title: Container Workload Segmentation
controls.description: Segregate container workloads to help contain attacks through isolation.

controls.title: Container Runtime Security
controls.description: Detect and remediate changes to running containers with container runtime protection tools.

controls.title: Cybersecurity Incident Management Plan
controls.description: Develop, document, and disseminate an agency-level cybersecurity incident management plan to respond to cybersecurity incidents.

controls.title: Risk Assessment
controls.description: Develop and document a risk assessment by {{ insert: param, pm-2_prm_1 }} and get it approved by {{ insert: param, pm-2_prm_2 }} prior to {{ insert: param, pm-2_prm_3 }} and conduct a review every {{ insert: param, pm-2_prm_4 }} day(s).

controls.title: System Security Plan (SSP) Development
controls.description: Develop and maintain a comprehensive System Security Plan (SSP) that accurately reflects the system characteristics and security controls in place for the organisation's systems and environments.

controls.title: Approval of Residual Risks
controls.description: Get acceptance and approval of the residual risks from agency's {{ insert: param, pm-4_prm_1 }}.

controls.title: Central Submission of Approved System Security Plan (SSP)
controls.description: Submit approved SSPs centrally to maintain a unified and up-to-date repository of security plans and practices.

controls.title: System Documentation
controls.description: Maintain detailed, up-to-date documentation of all system information and architecture.

controls.title: Certification
controls.description: Ensure that the Software as a Service (SaaS) provider is certified with {{ insert: param, pm-7_prm_1 }}.

controls.title: SaaS Whitelisting
controls.description: Maintain and enforce a whitelist of authorised software and services.

controls.title: Management Agents
controls.description: Install CSP management agents on hosts to remotely and securely manage their configurations.

controls.title: Automated Patch Management Tools
controls.description: Use automated patch management tools to facilitate security patching of operating systems and software included in the operating systems.

controls.title: Restricted Administrator Privileges
controls.description: Restrict administrator privileges by disabling remote login for the root/administrator user and restricting sudo/administrators group access for other users.

controls.title: Least Functionality
controls.description: Disable or remove unnecessary functions, system ports, protocols, software, and services on the host.

controls.title: Host System Hardening
controls.description: Harden the host configuration with reference to industry standards.

controls.title: Remote Administration
controls.description: Use remote administration tools to control and monitor remote access.

controls.title: Malware Protection
controls.description: Detect and quarantine malware on hosts with anti-malware tools.

controls.title: Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR)
controls.description: Monitor security threats on hosts with an EDR tool.

controls.title: End-of-Support (EOS) Assets
controls.description: Ensure deployed {{ insert: param, is-9_prm_1 }} assets have not reached end-of-support (EOS). Use of EOS assets will require risk acceptance by approved authority.

controls.title: Synchronise time clocks
controls.description: Synchronise internal clocks to a common reference time source.

controls.title: Central Domain Name Registration
controls.description: Register .gov.sg and .edu.sg domain names with GovTech as the sole registrar.

controls.title: DNS Security Extensions (DNSSEC)
controls.description: Implement DNS Security Extensions (DNSSEC) for public DNS records and servers.

controls.title: Defensive Domain Name Registration
controls.description: Register second (.sg) and third (.com.sg, .org.sg, .net.sg, .edu.sg) level domain name variants of the system's primary domain name.

controls.title: Singapore SMS Sender ID Registry Registration
controls.description: Register and use whitelisted SMS Sender IDs with the Singapore SMS Sender ID Registry for sending SMSes to members of the public.

controls.title: Push Protection for Secrets
controls.description: Configure the code repository to prevent secrets from being pushed to the repository.

controls.title: Default Branch Push Permissions
controls.description: Configure the code repository to prevent pushes (including force pushes) to the default branch.

controls.title: Continuous Integration (CI) Tests
controls.description: Require Continuous Integration (CI) tests to pass before merging into the default branch.

controls.title: Static Analysis
controls.description: Set up a static analysis job in the {{ insert: param, sd-4_prm_1 }}, and remediate or risk accept true positive vulnerability findings before deploying to production.

controls.title: Dependency Scanning
controls.description: Schedule a scan at least every {{ insert: param, sd-5_prm_1 }} day(s) in the {{ insert: param, sd-5_prm_2 }} to identify the use of vulnerable software libraries.

controls.title: Secret Detection
controls.description: Set up secret detection in the {{ insert: param, sd-6_prm_1 }} and remediate true positives within {{ insert: param, sd-6_prm_2 }} day(s).

controls.title: CI Environment Variable Secrets Management
controls.description: Protect environment variable secrets used in CI jobs by limiting them to protected pipelines and masking them in job logs.

controls.title: Deployment Environment Segregation
controls.description: Segregate production and non-production environments including applications, services, data, secrets, roles, and networks.

controls.title: Separate hosting
controls.description: Physically separate Government resources from non-Government resources.

controls.title: Physical Access Controls
controls.description: Implement physical access controls to prohibit unauthorised access to the hosting environment or network rooms.

controls.title: Software as a Service (SaaS) Service Level Agreement
controls.description: Obtain a service level agreement with the SaaS provider.

controls.title: Third Party Audit
controls.description: Conduct a(n) {{ insert: param, tp-2_prm_1 }} audit by an independent third-party at least every {{ insert: param, tp-2_prm_2 }} day(s).

controls.title: Scope for Offshoring
controls.description: Restrict offshore development to development and maintenance work.

controls.title: Attestation Report Review
controls.description: Review the {{ insert: param, tp-4_prm_1 }} attestation report every {{ insert: param, tp-4_prm_2 }} day(s) and ensure that outstanding exceptions or findings are remediated.

controls.title: Qualified Offshore Development Centre
controls.description: Engage offshore resources through a local third party that operates a {{ insert: param, tp-5_prm_1 }}.

controls.title: Supplier Assessments and Reviews
controls.description: Seek an assessment by {{ insert: param, tp-6_prm_1 }} on the risks associated with suppliers or contractors before using or subscribing to the service.

controls.title: Cryptographic Key Establishment
controls.description: Use industry-standard cryptographic key establishment schemes and key derivation methods.

controls.title: Cryptographic Key Rotation
controls.description: Rotate cryptographic keys every {{ insert: param, ck-2_prm_1 }} days.

controls.title: Cryptographic Key Management
controls.description: Implement cryptographic key management processes to ensure cryptographic keys are well-managed and safeguarded throughout their lifecycle.
